boundary: Game and early/late turn selection uses only archival metadata, excluding all earlier 14 calibration controls and initial 12-game held-out population. Exact T-1 historical static/roster data are resolved before current VCR race and mass comparisons. Target ship identity is obtained from current VCR and NOT predicted. Fed +50KT is a conditional documented component, NOT verified battle-phase activation. Unknown T-1 specs/rosters ABSTAIN; numeric nonmatches are not automatically errors or new rules. Cargo, Shield Generator, Horwasp, carrier RNG, captures and movement are not reconstructed. No production/executor/DB mutation.
